source: NCERT Class XII, India — People and Economy, Ch. 8 (Manufacturing Industries).

sections.heading: 1. Importance and Types
points: **Manufacturing** is the backbone of development — creates jobs, adds value, earns foreign exchange, reduces regional disparity.
Types by inputs: **agro-based** (cotton textiles, sugar) and **mineral-based** (iron & steel, cement, aluminium).
By ownership: **public, private, joint, cooperative** (e.g. Amul, sugar cooperatives).

sections.heading: 2. Major Industries
points: **Iron and Steel** — a basic industry; located on the **Chotanagpur plateau** (TISCO-Jamshedpur 1907, Bhilai, Rourkela, Durgapur, Bokaro).
**Cotton textiles** — the largest industry; Mumbai, Ahmedabad; jute in the Hugli basin (West Bengal).
**Sugar** — in UP/Bihar (north) and Maharashtra/TN (south, better quality).
**Petrochemicals, automobiles, IT** (Bengaluru = electronic capital), cement, fertiliser.

sections.heading: 3. Industrial Regions and Location
points: Major industrial regions: **Mumbai-Pune, Hugli (Kolkata), Bengaluru-Tamil Nadu, Gujarat, Chotanagpur, Delhi-NCR**.
Location factors: **raw materials, market, labour, power, capital, transport, government policy**.
**Agglomeration economies** cluster industries in regions.

sections.heading: 4. Liberalisation and Challenges
points: **Liberalisation (1991)** boosted private industry, FDI and IT/services.
Challenges: **regional imbalance, pollution, sick industries, competition, and infrastructure gaps**.
**Make in India** and industrial corridors aim to raise manufacturing's share of GDP.

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Agro-based (cotton, sugar) vs mineral-based (iron & steel, cement) industries.
TISCO Jamshedpur (1907); iron & steel on Chotanagpur plateau.
Cotton textiles = largest industry (Mumbai, Ahmedabad); jute = Hugli basin.
Bengaluru = IT/electronic capital.
Industrial regions: Mumbai-Pune, Hugli, Bengaluru-TN, Gujarat, Chotanagpur, Delhi-NCR.

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: **Iron and steel is a basic industry** on the **Chotanagpur plateau**.
**Cotton textiles = largest industry**; jute concentrated in the **Hugli basin**.
**Bengaluru = IT/electronic capital** of India.
Southern sugar (Maharashtra/TN) is of **better quality** than northern (UP/Bihar).
